steps.title: Two buzzers, one race
steps.text: Two players face off. One side buzzes with A and S, the other with K and L, or just tap your buttons.

steps.title: Phish or fine?
steps.text: Read the message. Buzz Phish if it's a scam, or Fine if it's safe.

steps.title: Fast and right
steps.text: You get six seconds. First right answer scores a hundred. A wrong buzz costs fifty and hands your rival a shot.

steps.title: Streaks and lessons
steps.text: Three in a row earns a bonus, and Shield explains every answer so you learn the red flags. Let's battle!
